component.name: Proto Clean
component.summary: Independent clean-room VPN client for Proton accounts

description.p: Proto Clean is an independent (clean-room) desktop and mobile client for Proton VPN: backend-browser login with saved credentials and TOTP auto-fill (or Proton's credentialless "Continue as guest" flow with no account), a free-server list with live loads, fastest-server auto-connect, WireGuard and OpenVPN tunnels, local blocklist ad-blocking, split tunneling, NAT-PMP port forwarding, IPv6 leak protection, an Xray proxy (VLESS REALITY with SNI masking and Trojan), 25+ protocol engines with multiprotocol chains and a Material Design 3 UI.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.

ul.li: Continue as guest: Proton's credentialless API flow (POST /auth/v4/sessions → /auth/v4/credentialless) — no account, no CAPTCHA, no Playwright. Free-tier servers only; one connection at a time. Auto-resumes on next launch via refresh-token. WireGuard certs obtained via the API; wg-quick config built locally (no downloads-page scraping).

Material Design 3 UI: HCT tonal palettes (CIELAB-backed), all 30+ MD3 color roles, MD3 widget styles (filled-pill / filled-tonal / text buttons, filled text fields with focus underline, pill tabs with secondary-container highlight, surface-container tables without hard borders). Seed colour is the Proto Clean pine-green #2f6d3f. Android app's Theme.kt is now a full MD3 colour scheme.
603 tests passing (12 new guest-mode tests, 25 new MD3 tests, 13 new controller-guest integration tests).

description.p: Multi-protocol engine layer: 25+ protocols with one UI.

ul.li: Built-in engines: Shadowsocks AEAD, Hysteria 2 (salamander), TUIC v5, MASQUE over QUIC, Cover-DTLS, IKEv2, Tor
lantern-box engine: VMess, ShadowsocksR, NaïveProxy, AmneziaWG 1.5/2.0, Reflex, WATER, Outline, ALGeneva
Clash, V2ray/V2fly and sing-box config import (or raw sing-box passthrough); subscription URLs
Cloudflare WARP hops before/after any protocol (oblivion-style registration)
Multiprotocol chains: client → engine → engine → internet
Import from clipboard, QR on screen, QR images and files

description.p: Link bonding (Speedify-style multi-adapter streams, net-merge-style balancing), bundled lantern-box samizdat engine (GPL-3 relicensing).
Xray proxy support (VLESS REALITY / Trojan), wider platform matrix (Windows 7+, macOS 10.15+, Android 8.0+), Flatpak.
